Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Papers, Please-like Grestin Border Checkpoint, day 1982.11.23. Initial Ministry of Admission bulletin (rules seen once: stamp ENTRY VISA, deny foreigners, admit Arstotzkan citizens only) was unread until dragged. Desk left; dark inspection area right with 'DRAG DOCUMENTS HERE'; shutter/window top-center; outside pavement top-right.

Observed controls: a document only moves if the drag starts inside its paper. Early clicks/drags at y~0.38-0.55 hit empty space; the bulletin sheet actually sat lower-right (roughly x=0.55-0.84, top edge ~y=0.75). Drag from ~x=0.66,y=0.83 leftward moved it to the bottom-left tray as a small white sheet. Dragging that tray sheet (~x=0.105,y=0.9) up into the dark area lays it flat as a large light-blue perforated page. Dragging the laid-out page back down-left to the tray returns it and clears the area. Long vertical drags flip the page between a blank side and a side headed 'AUDIO TRANSCRIPT'; short drags only reposition it. Scroll and clicks do not reveal text. Stamp tool is the brown object on the counter (coords vary across frames, about x=0.22-0.30, y=0.35-0.36). Clicking it picks up a small red stamp (hand cursor); a later click on the page drops it with no mark. Drags from the tool onto either side also return it to the counter with no visible imprint. White ring on the shutter box (~x=0.367,y=0.245) toggles on/off when clicked. Height scale (1.1-1.9) sometimes shows on the left wall. Silver cars pass at the top-right. Tray once also showed a grid tool and a brown 'kg' item. Actions are rejected with observation_age_limit if the screenshot is stale; wait or a fresh frame is required.

Failed: grabbing the bulletin from mid-screen; clicking the tray sheet to open it; stamping by click-while-held or drag-from-tool on blank and transcript sides; flipping, scrolling, clicking the header, and repositioning the transcript page (only the header ever appears, body stays blank); summoning anyone via the ring, the window ledge, clicks on/near the blue figure, or dragging the figure toward the window. Waits of 2-5s after ring clicks do not bring the figure in.

Current state: inspection area empty, white sheet back in the bottom-left tray, stamp on the counter, ring toggles but is not bringing anyone, blue figure still standing outside top-right (~x=0.79-0.82,y=0.12). Goal remains to process the bulletin and get an entrant to the booth. Unresolved: how a stamp actually registers, whether the transcript side should contain text, and whether the ring or the blue figure is the real call mechanism. Do not treat the ring toggle or the figure's lack of response as proven mechanics beyond the observed no-effect.
